segments.text:
V. 33.
Either make the tree good and its fruit good: or make the tree corrupt and its fruit corrupt—That is, you muſt allow, they are both good, or both bad. For if the Fruit is good, ſo is the Tree; if the Fruit is evil, ſo is the Tree alſo. For the tree is known by its fruit—As if he had ſaid, Ye may therefore know Me by fruits.—By my converting Sinners to GOD, you may know that GOD hath ſent me.
